Lease Abstraction 3: 
THIS LEASE AGREEMENT (the "Agreement") is made and entered into this seventeenth day of July, two thousand twenty-six, by and between the Landlord and Quick Print Shop (hereinafter referred to as "Tenant"), regarding the real property located at 550 Print Way (the "Premises").
Provided that the Tenant is not in default of any covenants or obligations contained herein beyond any applicable cure periods, the Tenant shall be granted a single option to extend the duration of this occupancy for one subsequent period of three years. To validly exercise this extension privilege, the Tenant must provide definitive written intent to the Landlord no later than ninety days prior to the initial expiration date specified below, failing which this option shall automatically lapse. Additionally, Tenant shall be responsible for its proportional share of all Common Area Maintenance expenses incurred by the Landlord. The Tenant’s share of said operating expenses is hereby fixed and established at ten percent of the total aggregate costs as determined by the Landlord’s annual accounting, payable within fifteen days of receipt of an invoice.
The term of this lease shall commence on August 1, 2026, and shall continue for a period of thirty-six full calendar months, expiring on July 31, 2029. In consideration for these rights, Tenant covenants to pay to the Landlord, without notice, demand, deduction, or set-off, a monthly base rent in the amount of Four Thousand Two Hundred and 00/100 Dollars. Said payments shall be remitted in advance on or before the first business day of each calendar month. Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date, and on each successive anniversary thereafter, the monthly base rent shall be subject to a fixed escalation adjustment of six percent of the then-current monthly base rent, which shall thereafter constitute the base rent for the subsequent twelve-month period.

model_output.escalation: 6% annual increase on each anniversary of the Commencement Date
model_output.cam: Tenant responsible for 10% of total Common Area Maintenance expenses, payable within 15 days of invoice
model_output.renewal_option: One 3-year extension option; requires written notice 90 days prior to expiration; tenant must not be in default
key_provisions: Rent payable without notice, demand, deduction, or set-off
Rent due on or before first business day of each month
